newsitem.title: USA: Auxer says can't explain stock's decline.
newsitem.headline: Auxer says can't explain stock's decline.

text.p: Auxer Industries Inc said on Tuesday that it was unaware of any reason to explain its weakened stock price over the past several weeks and stood by its acquisition plan.
"The company believes its business plan and proposed acquisition program represents a strong opportunity for Auxer's shareholders," the company said in a statement.
In addition, Auxer said it expected to announce the first of a series of acquisitions in the next 30 to 45 days.
